summary: An Instagram user (name never stated in the thread) who came to Derrek after their AI-influencer-style IG account with ~5,000 followers was permanently banned under community standards. Derrek diagnosed the ban from a login screenshot, quoted $3,000 for a permanent community-standards recovery, and they declined, choosing to restart instead. The conversation shifted to advice: their secondary account on the same email was integrity-flagged by association, old content can't be reposted without proper repurposing, and they asked whether Derrek had secured the username 'scarscar' for them. That username request is the open follow-up item.
key_facts: Permanent ban, community standards violation, confirmed from a login screenshot
Quoted $3,000 for permanent community-standards ban recovery; prospect declined due to price
Derrek noted price could be lower depending on ban type
Banned account had ~5,000 followers; was an AI-generated persona account
Likely ban cause: posted AI photo closely resembling a real influencer
Prospect has a second IG account on the same email with zero followers, now integrity-flagged by association
Advised old content can't be reused on a new account without repurposing (pixels, audio, metadata)
Open item: prospect asked whether Derrek secured the username 'scarscar'
Prospect also asked how to keep a future account from getting banned — warm lead for prevention/repurposing services
services_discussed: Instagram account recovery pricing tiers by ban type
Content repurposing to avoid duplicate-content detection
